sections.text: في حالة استخدام فراغ

Vacuum cleaning can be used, both before and after other 
 methods of cleaning to remove loose dirt and debris. It is a very effective 
 way to remove loose surface contamination from the windings without 
 scattering. Vacuum cleaning tools should be non metallic to avoid any damage 
 to the winding insulation.

items:
Vacuum cleaning can be used, both before and after other 
 methods of cleaning to remove loose dirt and debris. It is a very effective 
 way to remove loose surface contamination from the windings without 
 scattering. Vacuum cleaning tools should be non metallic to avoid any damage 
 to the winding insulation.

sections.text: Wiping

Surface contamination on the winding can removed using a soft 
 lint free wiping material. If contamination is oily, the wiping material can 
 be moistened with a safety type petroleum solvent. In hazardous locations, a 
 solvent such as inhibited methyl chloroform may be used but must be used 
 sparingly and immediately removed. While this solvent is non flammable under 
 ordinary conditions, it is toxic and proper health and safety precautions 
 should be followed while using it.

Keep core ducts completely clean. The difference in 
 temperature rise could be around 10 oC before and after cleaning.

sections.text: Clean the Exterior of the Motor

On open ventilated motor, screens and louvers over the inlet 
 air openings should not be allowed to accumulate any build up dirt, lint, etc. 
 that could restrict free air movement.

If the motor is equipped with air filters, they should be 
 replaced or cleaned and reconditioned at a frequency that is dictated by 
 conditions. It is better to replace or recondition filters too often that not 
 often enough.

Totally enclosed air to air cooled totally enclosed fan cooled 
 require special cleaning consideration. The external fan must be cleaned 
 thoroughly since any dirt build up not removed can lead unbalance and 
 vibration. All of the tubes of the air to air heat exchanger should be cleaned 
 using a suitable tube brush having synthetic fiber bristles.

Bearing Characteristics for Closed Cooling Water Pump 
Motor
إعادة التشحيم

It is advisable to regress when the motor is running to allow the new grease to 
be evenly distribute inside the bearing. before regressing, the inlet fitting 
should be thoroughly cleaned to prevent any accumulated dirt from being carried 
into the bearing with new grease. The outlet of grease drainage should be opened 
to allow the proper venting of old grease. Use grease gun to pump grease through 
grease nipple into bearing. After regressing operate the motor for 10-30 minutes 
to allow any الشحوم الزائدة للتنفيس.
Drive & Opp. Drive Bearing (Re-greasing Bearing )
Kind of grease : LITHIUM BASE NLGI#3
Period of re-greasing each 3000 hours
Selected grease MOBILUX 3 (260 GM)
Bearing Characteristics for service water Pump motor
Lubrication of Bearing
Upper bearing NU238 (oil lubrication )
Kind of oil : Turbine Oil; ISO VG 68
Make sure the oil quantity level
Max-center of gauge glass standstill
الحد الأدنى 6 ملم تحت مركز الزجاج المقياس

Otherwise, adjust the oil quantity level by feeding more or draining off the 
 oil
